capture_method: Unmocked run_tui with scripted key/draw terminal adapter; real ANSI application frames, not a native desktop window screenshot.

screens.name: sample-review
screens.annotation: Compare the observations and guides; feed corrections are explicit decisions.

screens.name: target-review
screens.annotation: All profile concentrations here are mmol/L; continue through the remaining targets.

screens.name: alternative-selection
screens.annotation: This choice follows the preview approval and calculation; Stop keeps no new session.

screens.name: rounded-doses
screens.annotation: Stocks are separate product solutions; include every addition in the final 1,000 L.

screens.name: nutrient-bounds
screens.annotation: Target, nominal, low and high are elemental mg/L; nitrogen is reported as N.

screens.name: uncertainty-notes
screens.annotation: Sampled pH and the reserved sodium ceiling pass; the overall status still needs review.

rendering: Actual ANSI frames rasterized with Cascadia Mono, 20 px; original visible text, ANSI colors and inverse selection retained. Numbered heading, gold outline and caption added outside/around the relevant rows. No calculation values edited.
profile_hash_basis: SHA-256 of UTF-8 LF bytes in the published example. Captured input used CRLF; its raw hash is capture_profile_sha256. Normalizing only CRLF to LF reproduces the published example byte-for-byte.
frame_hash_basis: SHA-256 of exact visible text joined with LF and one final LF; portable across repository checkouts.
